verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own Auto-Sync feature commits, pulls and pushes automatically whenever changes are detected, and Background Sync keeps this running while other apps are in use, though it uses location and extra battery and pauses after long periods without changes. Beyond that, automation runs through its Shortcuts actions and x-callback-url scheme, which are triggered actions rather than autonomous background jobs. Any recurring scheduling would come from the iOS Shortcuts host platform, which earns no credit here. Missing for 10: user-definable autonomous automations beyond the fixed sync behavior, recurring schedule support, background execution that does not pause, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: _Auto-Sync_ does all of this for you, committing, pulling and pushing whenever changes are detected.
Turn on _Background Sync_ to keep syncing while you use other apps, which uses your location and extra battery and pauses after long periods without changes.
Working Copy supports automation through the Shortcuts app where files and other data can flow between actions.
